facts.claim: Project began in January 2024.
Original completion scheduled for December 2024.
Initial team consisted of 12 developers, 3 designers, and 2 project managers.
First internal prototype completed in April 2024.
Beta release scheduled for September 2024.
Project update October 2024 states beta released in August 2024.
Internal note says beta release delayed until October 2024 due to database performance problems.
January staffing report lists 17 members: 12 developers, 3 designers, 2 project managers.
June report states team grew to 21 members after four engineers and two testers joined.
Management summary states team consisted of 18 people at its peak.
November personnel report lists 20 active members.
Approved project budget was $480,000.
Finance department recorded expenditure of $310,000 by end of August 2024.
September financial summary reports total spending of $365,000.
Annual project review states project had spent $410,000 by end of July 2024.
Annual review estimates final project cost will be approximately $525,000.
First performance test reported average ticket-processing time of 4.2 seconds.
July engineering report recorded average processing time of 3.8 seconds.
August report claimed average processing time fell to 2.1 seconds after database optimization.
September customer-support survey reported users experienced average processing time of approximately 5 seconds.
Engineering team attributed performance problems primarily to inefficient database queries.
October 2024 security team investigated unauthorized access incident.
Incident report states event occurred on October 14 and affected 37 customer accounts.
Management summary states incident occurred on October 12 and affected 27 accounts.
Security team concluded compromised employee credentials were used to gain access.
No evidence of customer password theft was found according to security report.
December project report states platform ready for production deployment.
Engineering note states several critical performance issues remained unresolved.
Product manager final update describes project as successfully completed in December 2024.
Operations document says production launch postponed until February 2025.
Management considers Nova Support Platform an important strategic project.
